name: data-noodler
description: Data Noodler: ask about your Google Analytics 4 and Search Console data, read-only, with reporting discipline and credential self-service.

interface.shortDescription: Ask about your Google Analytics and Search Console data
interface.longDescription: Data Noodler: read-only access to the Google Analytics 4 and Search Console properties your own Google account can already see. Includes cheap property lookup, reporting discipline that keeps metric and date-range choices explicit, and a credential status tool that explains the weekly reauth rather than failing silently.
defaultPrompt: How much traffic did admissions.example.edu get last month?
Which of our sites send the most traffic to admissions.example.edu?
Is my Google Analytics credential still valid?
